case_number: 2025 INSC 255; CIVIL APPEAL NO(s) OF 2025 (Arising out of SLP(C)Nos.25736-25737 of 2023)
summary: Construction of GOI Notification dated 25.02.2021 under Kerala Conservation of Paddy Land and Wetland Act, 2008; exemption from reclamation fee for land up to 25 cents; fee of 10% for land >25 cents, 20% for >1 acre; clarification on applicability to land divided pre-2017; fee calculation based on fair value; High Court interpretation upheld; State's appeal dismissed.
legal_provisions_cited: Kerala Conservation of Paddy Land and Wetland Act, 2008
Kerala Paddy and Wetland (Amendment Act 2018) s.12(9), s.27A
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; impugned judgment of High Court upholding partial fee exemption affirmed.
